reason: Stream R (F11) replaces the archived-conversation excerpt ranker in ChatService._model_context and adds a conversation.search Core tool. New pure module context_retrieval.py (paragraph-aligned chunking, BM25 with rarity-weighted identifier boost, tail-aware query, optional dense RRF via the knowledge index's local model when already ready), new conversation_search.py tool (LOCAL_READ analysis tool bound to one chat session, active projection up to the latest ready snapshot), conversation_search_components in runtime_platform.py, ChromaKnowledgeIndex.embed, conversation.search added to RETRIEVAL_TOOL_NAMES, and chat.py wiring (excerpt selection, offering the tool on compacted tool turns, recording it in the request snapshot, rebuilding it on resume). Selected: the two new test files; test_context.py (context/limits/lexical_score kept for missions); test_chat.py (compaction, excerpts, resume, runtime switch); every file whose tests drive a compacted prepare (history content fidelity, model output budget, project instructions, turn preflight latency snapshot reuse, API stream context, turn prompt cache); restart recovery of rerunnable retrieval reads; knowledge index (new embed method); structured results and tool catalog (exact tool spec sets and resume rebuild alongside the new components); and the compaction no-reasoning node. exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI, Rust or visible layout changes; the tool's activity renders through the existing generic native tool card using its display_name. Other tool-spec-set tests (tool suggestions, subagents, browser companion) never compact a conversation, so the tool is not offered there.
